provenance: Opus 5.5 subscription CLI draft; host source review and execution audit
limitations: This assumes each 3x3 conway sprite touches all four edges of its 3x3 box, as the archived bounding-box solver and all fixtures imply. If a sprite left an empty edge row or column, its true offset inside the quadrant could not be recovered, and the crop is placed top-left. The program also assumes the background palette[0] is not the divider colour; the generator guarantees this because the cross colour is drawn from non-background colours. I found no contradiction between the fixtures and the rule. I have not run any tests.
